thread:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — Q4 hosted capacity planning. We have an accredited-model rollout (low-latency SLAs, additional compliance checks) landing week 6 of Q4. We need a concrete acquisition plan for EU + US to guarantee 99.9 latency SLOs for the first 3 weeks of the rollout.
Tony Alvarez: Do you have target GPU-hours for that window? Also what's the preferred instrument — buy vs 3mo lease vs spot/short-term?
Maya Chen: Baseline projection: 9.5M GPU-hours for whole Q4, with a 2-week pre-rollout validation window requiring dedicated racks for evals ~120k GPU-hours. Expect ~18% surge at launch. Lead times: vendor quotes show 10–16w for physical purchases, 3–6w for lined-up leases.
Sophia Park: From finance: Opex vs CapEx call: we can approve up to $1.2M in short-term leases if it reduces predicted SLA breach risk. Any cheaper alternative (quantization, burst proxies)?
Anika Rao: We can reduce token cost via 4-bit quantized variants for non-critical paths, but accredited rollout must use FP16 or validated quantized kernels — ops can't touch the accredited results. That means the dedicated eval fleet must be full-precision.
Jordan Lee: Network/cluster note: eu-west racks currently have 6 spare nodes but <48h warmup for KV-cache priming if we cold-start. If we go with leases, we should plan a 72h warm pool soak per region.
Maya Chen: Proposed approach: (1) Reserve a 12-week lease tranche to cover baseline + 10% buffer, (2) Buy 1 rack in US as long-term hedge, (3) Tactical 4–8 week leases for EU launch week spikes, (4) pre-warm policy: 72h soak + KV prefill job.
Tony Alvarez: Can you paste the model of GPU-hours by week? I want to run cost sensitivity vs spot risk.
Maya Chen: Pasted weekly breakout below: code block start
```
week_1: 800000
week_2: 900000
week_3: 1100000  # rollout week, +50% for validated traffic
week_4: 950000
week_5: 900000
week_6: 850000
week_7: 830000
week_8: 800000
week_9: 780000
week_10: 760000
week_11: 740000
week_12: 730000
```
code block end
Sophia Park: Running quick math: tranche A (12-week lease) covers weeks 1–12 baseline = ~9.5M hrs. Short leases for weeks 3–4 spike = extra ~200k hrs. Budget hit estimated $980k if leases at market; buys amortized drop to $700k/quarter but 16w lead time.
Jordan Lee: Risk log: vendor shipping window is still the wildcard. If purchase order now, earliest racks in region = week 8. That doesn't help launch week 3.
Anika Rao: Operational tasks to make short-term leases workable: (a) automation to swap model-variants to leased fleet, (b) a KV-prefill job that runs across the warm pool, (c) metrics guardrails to ensure latency tail doesn't regress when we flip. I can own (a)+(b).
Maya Chen: Action items: @Tony run cost-sensitivity with these numbers and produce a simple decision rule (expected SLA penalty vs lease cost). @Sophia confirm budget sign-off for up to $1.2M in leases. @Jordan coordinate warm-pool automation + verify 72h soak ops runbook. @Anika set KV-prefill job and a canary test.
Tony Alvarez: Will do. Quick Q: fallback region — do we have capacity to route EU traffic to us-east without breaking data residency? If not, we must secure EU leases.
Jordan Lee: We can route but only for non-accredited customers. Accredited cohort requires EU residency per compliance. So fallback is limited.
Maya Chen: Given that, we need the EU tactical leases regardless. Final recommendation (tentative): secure 12-week leases covering baseline across both regions, issue PO for 1 US rack, and purchase a 4-week burst block in EU for the rollout spike. Sophia sign-off required.
Sophia Park: Approving the plan contingent on Tony's decision rule doc. :thumbsup: I'll provision an interim PO for the 4-week EU burst once Tony confirms numbers.
infra-bot: [alert] capacity-sim-run completed — projected SLA breach probability without EU burst: 27% over rollout week. With proposed leases: 1.8%.
Maya Chen: Thanks — that gap is decisive. I'll draft the procurement email and vendor list. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we'll lock the 12-week lease RFP and the US purchase order.
Tony Alvarez: I'll drop the decision rule doc in #eng-fin by 1600 PT.
Anika Rao: I'll start the KV-prefill job template and post the run instructions here.
Jordan Lee: I'll schedule warm-pool soak windows and tag infra-oncall for rollout week.
Maya Chen: Good. Closing loop: aim to have contracts signed ~week 0 of Q4 to hit week 3 launch. :spiral_calendar:
